method: BVH broadphase and strict non-coplanar edge/triangle intersections on actual transformed exported triangles
intentional_contact_policy: All crossings retained. A50mm radius around each relevant declared hinge axis is separately counted as an authored possible-contact region, not automatically proven intentional. Translation gear has no excluded hinge region.
numeric_contact_policy: A20micrometre minimum triangle-plane straddle tolerance identifies contacts below candidate export precision. Raw crossings and examples remain recorded; this is not solid-volume penetration depth or general clearance.
limitations: Not a continuous swept-volume or penetration-depth solver.
Coplanar overlap, vertex/edge-only contact and complete containment are not detected.
No-hit samples do not certify clearance between samples.
Preserved internal surfaces may overlap intentionally; any crossing requires native visual/geometry review.
Only named cargo/gear pairs tested; kit and all other surface pairs excluded.
